accessibility.description: Nekogui reads dialogue and supported interface text through Prism, announces choices, and adds keyboard menu navigation, with a launcher offering English and Japanese mod languages. The Load menu is rough, loading a specific save slot during play is not fully supported, and late-game choices have not been fully verified; the author advises saving often because random crashes may occur. The GOG Director's Cut works as is, while the Steam version needs the separate 18+ uncensored DLC from JAST Store.
